camera: cam02 at roughly 33.952940,-83.376606, on the SW corner of S Lumpkin St x Baldwin St, looking NE. In frame that puts north to the upper left, east to the right, and south off the bottom-right corner. The sidewalk directly under the camera is Zone_09.
note: Semantics from the user's hand sketch (2026-08-17): roads 6/7/15, crosswalks 1/4/5, diagonal crossing crosswalks 2/3, sidewalks 8-14. S Lumpkin runs N-S, Baldwin runs E-W, and they are two different streets. This is a T junction: Baldwin ends here and has an east arm only, so the three arms N/E/S are the whole intersection, not a four-arm junction with one arm missing. The S Lumpkin south leg leaves frame at the bottom-right corner, so Zone_16 was added as a gate on the user's suggestion.

Zone_16.note: The south leg leaves frame with no roadway to draw, so this is a 300 px band on the screenline the user positioned. Direction is not encoded in the band: flow_typed decides a movement from the order of the arm sequence, so one gate serves both entering and leaving. Width was set from data - vehicle steps there run 79 px median, 256 px at p95, so a zero-width line would be stepped over.

arms_note: Three arms, which is complete for a T junction: Zone_07 (S Lumpkin north), Zone_15 (Baldwin east), Zone_16 (S Lumpkin south gate). Six movements, all of them countable.
ped_groups_note: Pedestrian destinations are reported as five directions, set by the user on 2026-08-17 and named from the Google map: Lumpkin N (West) is the 450 S Lumpkin St frontage, Lumpkin N (Brown Hall) is the far side facing Joseph E Brown Hall, Lumpkin S (Correll Hall) runs south past Correll Hall and Terry College, Baldwin E heads east past Comparative Literature, and Fine Arts is the corner by the Fine Arts Building. Zone_17/18/19 are off-frame exit bands: the camera cannot see the far corners, so a walk that leaves the picture is recorded by the edge it left through instead of being dropped.
